gui.controls.title: Controls
controls.walk: Walk (up is where the camera is looking)
controls.run: Run: tap W twice (you keep running while you hold it)
controls.crouch: Crouch (one tap; another, stand up). Crouching you walk slowly, and what you place doesn't join what's next to it. Swimming, you sink a little
controls.use: Use what you're holding: chop, mine, water, sow, fish, attack, eat, place… Hold to keep going.
controls.jump: Jump (with a dialogue open, continue). Swimming, rise higher; next to the shore, jump out
controls.interact: Interact with what you point at with the mouse (2 tiles away at most; pointing at nothing, with the nearest thing): talk, doors, chests, stations, sleep, harvest, animals
controls.rotate: Rotate what you're about to place (aim with the mouse: up to 4 tiles). Held, it keeps turning; tapped, in 15° steps, snapping to the tiles
controls.camera_turn: Turn the camera around you (hold: smooth turn)
controls.camera_tilt: Raise the camera until you almost see from above, or lower it to ground level
controls.zoom: Zoom the camera in and out
controls.view: First or third person (in first person, <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> look up and down)
controls.windows: Inventory (what you carry and your clothes), crafting and building
controls.players: While you hold it, who is playing
controls.chat: Chat and commands (/help to see them). Ops (given in the server terminal with /op) have /gamemode, /tp, /give, /kill, /weather, /gamerule…; the admin also has /account, to create accounts
